"[[Hypixel SkyBlock OST#tuna_sandwich|tuna_sandwich]]" ([[#Catch a Fish|Catch a Fish]]) }} The {{Zone|Carnival}} is a [[Location]] on the {{Zone|Hub Island}} that appears when {{NPCSprite|Foxy}} is [[Mayor Election|elected]] with her {{Pink|Chivalrous Carnival}} perk: it contains minigames that reward {{Carnival Tokens}}, which can be spent from {{NPCSprite|Doug}} shop. Each minigame costs {{Item|Carnival Ticket|amount=5}}s to play, and rewards {{Carnival Tokens|1}} for every {{green|100}} points. {{ZoneText|Talk to the &aCarnival Leader&f.|Complete goals in various &eCarnival &fgames.|Upgrade seasonal perks.}} == Minigames == The '''Carnival''' currently features {{green|3}} different minigames. Each has its own designated game area, NPC, and a tool which players use to play. A minigame can be started by talking to an NPC responsible for that game. To start a game, the player must have an empty hotbar slot for the designated tool to be given. After playing, one can read their yearly and lifetime scores in each game by talking to {{NPCSprite|Chantelle}} near the entrance of the {{Zone|Carnival}}. {| class="wikitable" !Game !NPC !Location !Tool |- |Fruit Digging |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Pirateman}} |{{Coords|-107|73|-2}} |{{Item|Carnival Shovel}} |- |Zombie Shootout |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Cowboy}} |{{Coords|-103.5|70|8.5}} |{{Item|Carnival Dart Tube}} |- |Catch a Fish |{{NPCSprite|Carnival Fisherman}} |{{Coords|-81.5|72|-0.5}} |{{Item|Carnival Rod}} |} === Fruit Digging === The goal is to earn as many points as possible by using the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} to dig up {{gold|Fruits}} scattered in a {{green|7}}x{{green|7}} grid of sand, within {{green|5}} minutes. *The grid consists of: ** {{green|34}} {{gold|Fruits}} of {{green|8}} different kinds, each with different points values and abilities; ** {{green|10}} {{Red|Bombs}} which destroy adjacentIn the context of '''Fruit Digging, '''"adjacent" means in a {{green|3}}x{{green|3}} grid. undiscovered {{gold|Fruits}}. ** {{green|5}} {{Yellow|Rums}} which disable the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} ability for the next dig. * The {{Item|Carnival Shovel}} can dig {{green|15}} times. It has {{green|3}} '''dowsing''' abilities: ** {{Red|'''Mines'''}} tells how many {{red|Bombs}} are adjacent to the block dug. ** {{Aqua|'''Anchor'''}} tells the position of the lowest scoring {{gold|Fruit}} near the block dug. ** {{Orange|'''Treasure'''}} tells the highest scoring {{gold|Fruit}} adjacent to the block dug. {| class="wikitable sortable" ! {{gold|Fruit}} !! Points Given !! # Per Board !! Ability |- | Dragonfruit || 1200 || 1 || {{bc}} |- | Mango || 300 || 10 || {{bc}} |- | Coconut || 200 || 3 || Prevents a {{Red|Bomb}} from exploding for the next dig, if dug. |- | Apple || 0 || 8 || {{Green|+100}} points per {{Green|Apple}} dug OR blown up by Watermelon up to that point. |- | Cherry || 200 || 2 || {{Green|+300}} points per {{Green|Cherry}} dug OR blown up by Watermelon up to that point. |- | Pomegranate || 200 || 4 || Multiplies the points earned from the next dig by {{Green|1.5x}}.
If the next dig is Watermelon, the subsequently revealed fruit(s) are {{red|not}} multiplied. |- | Durian || 800 || 2 || Multiplies the points earned from the next dig by {{Red|0.5x}}.
If the next dig is Watermelon, the subsequently revealed fruit(s) are {{green|not}} multiplied. |- | Watermelon || 100 || 4 || Reveals a random {{gold|Fruit}} in a tile adjacent to itself (or a random tile if all adjacent tiles are destroyed/revealed): * granting {{red|0.5x}} of its point value and activating its ability, even if it is a Watermelon; * without consuming a use on the {{Item|Carnival Shovel}}. Its '''dowsing''' ability is used after the watermelon chain is revealed. |- |} === Catch a Fish === The goal is to catch as many {{cyan|Fish}} as possible using the {{Item|Carnival Rod}} within {{green|100}} seconds: *{{cyan|Fish}} spawn, swim erratically in a pond before despawning. They are caught by hooking onto them and holding {{Keypress|Right-Click}} to reel them until the progress bar above them fills. The progress bar fills at varying speeds with {{red|Red}} being the fastest and {{yellow|Yellow}} being the slowest. * {{gold|Catch Streak Bonus}}: {{Green|5}} bonus points are awarded per catch in a row, up to {{Green|50}} bonus points per catch. There is also a {{Green|10%}} chance to gain {{Orange|double points}}. This resets after failing to catch a fish or {{green|3}} seconds without hooking onto one. * The {{Item|Carnival Rod}} has infinite uses. * The player is immobile. {| class="wikitable" ! Fish Type !! &f[name] &7has been restored.}} |} == NPCs == {{Location NPCs}} == Trivia == *Abilities are disabled while in the {{Zone|Carnival}}, and you cannot access [[Storage]], the [[Ender Chest]], or [[Backpacks]] during a Carnival game. *The player is unable to cast fishing rods (except the {{Item|Carnival Rod}}) in or near the {{Zone|Carnival}}. *The player gets the Mining Fatigue effect while playing a Carnival game. *The Carnival closes {{green|15}} minutes before {{NPCSprite|Foxy}} leaves office, and players are no longer able to start new games, but they can finish any existing games. {{NPCSprite|Doug}} sticks around for {{green|5}} more minutes. == Gallery == Carnival.png|'''Carnival''' area as seen from the north-east side Carnival (north-west).png|'''Carnival''' area as seen
